name: nexus-map
description: Planejador multimodal de rotas baseado em dados geográficos reais (carro, a pé, metrô/trilhos e avião).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexus/server" "npm run dev -w @nexus/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/server && npm run build -w @nexus/client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
